The opening identifies the actual MZ/HMT recursions and W26 profile input without repeating the inherited moduli setup; the loop functional is explicitly signed and the diagram legend/table columns have stated meanings. The publication prose nevertheless contains six undefined bare 'W26' references while the cited bibliography label is [WLQ+26], so the workspace shorthand needs replacement by author names or an actual citation (ACADEMIC-004).

The exact recursions are assigned to MZ15 Section 2/HMT25 Theorem 4.3; HMT/s03 provide the uniform remainder input, and the signed moments, small-vertex derivations and core enumeration have their own arguments. citation_precision.evidence: The primary comparisons support the Y=0 common-amplitude cancellation, reversed first-deficit sign, inverse-complexity to inverse-genus conversion, full low-degree increments and the W26 beta term with -1/2 outside its A braces.
